style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE hazel grouse, barred grey brown plumage, black throat, small crest
second_characters: two ground squirrels in caps, huge at the lens, one cap bright blue, the other cap violet pink

props.turntable: ONE round packing turntable under his feet, spinning him on the spot
props.tray: ONE metal roasting tray, his size, shoved at him

environment: marketplace sorting floor at noon, a mountain of goods filling the frame to its top edge: pots, flat screens, armchairs, kettles, socks, pacifiers, a floor light on a tall stand, no open sky
lighting: flat white daylight, cool edge left, warm fill right
motion_rule: the turntable whips the hero round on the spot and he never stops: he hurls goods off the heap every beat, wings thrown the full frame width, beak to the lens. The world flies INTO the lens: pots, socks and squirrels rush at the glass every beat. The camera never stops and circles him, new shot size every beat, medium to close. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, speech ends by 6.20, then the tray
audio.lip_sync: the bird speaks on camera, beak to the lens every spoken beat, beak opens on every syllable, empty while speaking
audio.pronunciation: kor-ZI-na, pus-TA, ye-SHCHO, mar-ket-PLEYS, ZNA-yet, NUZH-no

timeline.a: whips round on the turntable, hurling a pot off the heap into the lens; the blue cap tumbles across the glass
swings back the full width, dragging socks off the mountain; the violet cap shoves a kettle at the glass
throws both wings up, kicking an armchair off the heap into the lens; both squirrels dive under it
spins back beak first, tearing pacifiers off a string; the blue cap climbs the lens with a kettle
rips a flat screen out of the heap, swinging it full width; the violet cap hurls socks over the glass
beats both wings at the heap and it collapses at the lens, beak to the glass; both squirrels pour out of it
whips round through the falling goods, wings edge to edge; the blue cap throws a pot past his head
kicks the floor light over into the lens; the violet cap catches it at the glass
sweeps the last kettles at the lens, beak filling the frame; both squirrels shove goods back
both squirrels dive away from the lens, the heap draining into the depth behind him, he whips round alone
he drops into the metal tray, wings thrown edge to edge, his body filling the frame
a squirrel paw packs socks and pacifiers round him, he kicks them back at the lens
the other paw closes on the tray and lifts it, the goods mountain rushing past below
he swings up past the heap in the tray, beak at the lens, pots sweeping across the glass

must_appear: at 0.00 he hurls a pot off the heap as the turntable whips him round, goods filling the frame; two ground squirrels in caps, one bright blue and one violet pink, cross the lens in the opening beat; the tray shoved at him at 6.20, his own size; he drops into it at 6.95, wings full width; a paw lifts the tray at 8.35
